items.briefing:
Microsoft has released its August security updates, patching nearly 400 vulnerabilities across its products. All Australian staff should ensure their Windows devices and Microsoft software are updated as soon as possible. Separately, a ransomware group called Gunra is actively exploiting security flaws in Fortinet products and can bypass multi-factor authentication — if your organisation uses Fortinet equipment, alert your IT team immediately.

A reminder that strong identity management — controlling who has access to what — remains one of the best defences against cyber incidents. **Practical tip:** Check that your Windows device has installed this month's updates by going to Settings > Windows Update and clicking "Check for updates."

featured.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
featured.quote: Critical infrastructure ransomware gang bypasses MFA using Fortinet exploits, posing severe Australian risks.
